_doc: Slice #174 — days-to-sell prediction tunables. Pure deterministic predictor: expectedDays = baseline(segment) / demandMultiplier × agingMult, clamped to bounds. The demandMultiplier (price-elasticity × heat) is the SHARED model in data/demand-elasticity.json (slice #276) — this file only owns the days-to-sell-specific baselines, aging shape, bounds, and confidence. Confidence falls with extrapolation distance (above-market weighted heavier) and rises with the count of live comps backing the market estimate.
